entities.summary: Badou Jack is a Swedish professional boxer. He has held world titles in three weight classes, including the World Boxing Council (WBC) super-middleweight title from 2015 to 2017, the World Boxing Association (WBA) light-heavyweight title in 2017, and the WBC cruiserweight title twice between 2023 and 2025. As an amateur, he represented Gambia at the 2008 Olympics, reaching the first round of the middleweight bracket.
